title: Refund-Reason Relief for Damaged and Undelivered Items
content:
**Rule.** Under the refund-without-return reversal schedule of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships, the reason for the refund and the program of the order add to the relief fraction of the reversal. The refund reason is the one on the refund record, and the program is the one the order is held in, both on Northgate Store and Online Orders.

| Refund made because the item was | Order program | Added to the relief fraction |
|---|---|---|
| damaged on arrival | any | 0.2 |
| never received | Northgate Ship to Home, Northgate Same-Day Delivery or Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery | 0.1 |
| never received | any other program | nothing |

**Hypothetical illustration.** A never-received refund on a Same-Day Delivery order adds 0.1; a never-received refund on a Drive Up order adds nothing.
